scenario.summary: Guest checks the Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified highlight badges on the home page product cards and the remaining-highlights count, opens the WaterSense highlight and checks the Back to Product link, then returns home.
steps: Verify Free Shipping, WaterSense and BIO Certified badges are visible
Verify the '+N' remaining highlights count equals the sheet value
Click the WaterSense badge, verify Back to Product
evidence: featured = HOME_FEATURED_PRODUCTS_OF_STORE {store, minProducts 1}: the products of the first Product List widget of the store's published home page, in display order (approved key; atstage 2026-11-03: z-25100011, z-26597945, z-4567890, z-09876).

The badge locators are page-wide (first imgFreeShipping / imgWatersenseEpaCertified / imgBioCertified / listShowMoreHighlights on the page), i.e. the first featured card that carries them. tda rows (2026-11-11): featured product 1 z-25100011 has Highlights FreeShipping, WaterSenseCertified, BIOCertified, APIAutomation (4, 3 shown -> '+1'); products 2-4 carry only APIAutomation.

REVIEW (no highlights need): the badges come from whichever featured card carries them, and no key ties PRODUCT_WITH_HIGHLIGHTS to the home widget. Tried (2026-11-11, reverted): an optional sku param on PRODUCT_WITH_HIGHLIGHTS linked to @featured.product1Sku; readiness gave ZERO_ROWS for z-25100011 even with BIO + WaterSense only (the key's PIM attribute / publish rules do not find it, though ZnodePimProduct.Highlights lists the codes), so the approved key was left unchanged. The sheet RemainingHighlightsCount '1' (homePage!B27) stays expected-output (featured product 1: 4 highlights - 3 shown). Closed (user decision 2026-11-11): kept as recorded expected-output, no new key.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
